result.summary: Found 2 major visual issues: restaurant cards are partially or completely cut off, preventing users from seeing important information.

issues.description: Third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccol) is partially cut off on the right side, obscuring part of the restaurant name
issues.suggestion: Adjust the carousel/grid layout to ensure all cards are fully visible, or implement proper horizontal scrolling with visible overflow indicators

issues.description: Second restaurant card in 'Popular right now' section is incomplete - the card shows the image and '-100%' badge but the restaurant name, rating, delivery time, and other details are cut off below the visible viewport
issues.suggestion: Ensure all card content is properly contained within the viewport or implement scrolling; verify that card height is sufficient to display all required information (restaurant name, rating, delivery time, cuisine type, delivery cost)
